title: Settings
saveToLibraryHint: Every file made by a tool is filed automatically.
storageUnknown: This browser does not report available space.
persistOn: Persistent storage: the browser will not clear your library on its own.
persistOff: The browser may clear the library if space runs low. Install the app and make a backup to avoid that.
persistDenied: The browser declined. Installing the app often helps.
backupHint: Export the whole library (files, annotations, shelves, signatures) as a ZIP archive, to restore on this device or another.
backupFailed: The backup failed. The library may be too large for this device's memory.
restoreFailed: This archive is not a valid PidiElf backup.
installed: PidiElf is installed on this device.
installHint: To install PidiElf, use your browser menu (“Install” or “Add to Home screen”).
installIos: On iPhone and iPad: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
eraseHint: Empties the library, annotations, signatures and preferences on this device.
eraseText: The library, annotations, signatures and preferences will be deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
